THEBRUTE-KARMA_STRIKE.description:

THEBRUTE-DISTORT.title: Distort
THEBRUTE-INCINERATE.title: Incinerate

THEBRUTE-POSSESSION.description:
Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
[red]Vakuu will play the next{PossessionPower:cond:==1?|>1? {}|} {PossessionPower:plural:turn|turns} for you.[/red]
THEBRUTE-RAZOR_FORM.title: Razor Form
THEBRUTE-RAZOR_FORM.description: Whenever you lose Max HP, gain {RazorFormPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-LIQUIDATE.title: Liquidate
THEBRUTE-FULMINATE.title: Fulminate
THEBRUTE-FULMINATE.description:
Gain {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] X times this turn.
Gain {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] X times next turn.
THEBRUTE-CRASH.title: Crash
THEBRUTE-POISE.title: Poise
THEBRUTE-POISE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Amount:plural:a card|[blue]{}[/blue] cards} to [gold]Exhaust[/gold] from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-ENGORGE.title: Engorge
THEBRUTE-ENGORGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], raise your Max HP by {MaxHp:diff()}.
If not, gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
THEBRUTE-PROTOTYPE.title: Prototype
THEBRUTE-PROTOTYPE.description: Whenever you gain or inflict a buff or debuff, gain {PrototypePower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] this turn.
THEBRUTE-UNMAKE.title: Unmake
THEBRUTE-EXPLOIT.title: Exploit
THEBRUTE-EXPLOIT.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Choose {Cards:cond:>1?{Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}|a card} in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
THEBRUTE-EXPLOIT.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Amount:plural:a card|[blue]{}[/blue] cards} to play and [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
THEBRUTE-TORMENT.title: Torment
THEBRUTE-TORMENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you gained or lost [gold]Gold[/gold] this turn, gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
THEBRUTE-RAG_ON.title: Rag On
THEBRUTE-WARP.title: Warp
THEBRUTE-BRACE.title: Brace
THEBRUTE-BRACE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put {Cards:cond:>1?{Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}|a card} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-BRACE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Amount:plural:a card|[blue]{}[/blue] cards} to put on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-WALL_OF_THORNS.title: Wall of Thorns
THEBRUTE-STOCKADE.title: Stockade
THEBRUTE-COLLAPSE.title: Collapse
THEBRUTE-SCHEME.title: Scheme
THEBRUTE-SCHEME.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Next turn, gain {TemporaryThornsUpNextTurnPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] for that turn.
THEBRUTE-LEVERAGE.title: Leverage
THEBRUTE-LEVERAGE.description: Whenever an enemy hits you once, it takes {LeveragePower:cond:==200?double|==300?triple|{LeveragePower:diff()}%} damage from your [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-HYSTERIA.title: Hysteria
THEBRUTE-HYSTERIA.description:
At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
If you end your turn with no {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP and {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold] at the start of the next turn.
THEBRUTE-HEDGE.title: Hedge
THEBRUTE-HEDGE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you gained or lost [gold]Gold[/gold] this turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] {Repeat:cond:>1?{Repeat:diff()} additional {Repeat:plural:times|times}|an additional time}.
THEBRUTE-DEATH_WISH.title: Death Wish
THEBRUTE-DEATH_WISH.description: Whenever you lose Max HP, add {DeathWishPower:cond:==1?a random Attack|>1?{DeathWishPower:diff()} random Attacks} into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. {DeathWishPower:cond:>1?They're|It's} free to play until played.
THEBRUTE-TRANSMUTE.title: Transmute
THEBRUTE-TRANSMUTE.description:
Add [gold]Replay[/gold] to {Cards:cond:>1?{Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}|a card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
{Cards:cond:>1?They cost|It costs} an extra {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
THEBRUTE-TRANSMUTE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Amount:plural:a card|[blue]{}[/blue] cards} to add [gold]Replay[/gold] and a Max HP cost to.
THEBRUTE-HOSTILE_TAKEOVER.title: Hostile Takeover
THEBRUTE-HOSTILE_TAKEOVER.description:
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
ALL enemies lose {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEBRUTE-FRUSTRATION.title: Frustration
THEBRUTE-FRUSTRATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
THEBRUTE-BEATING.title: Beating
THEBRUTE-BEATING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each time you lost Max HP this combat.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}
THEBRUTE-FRAGMENT.title: Fragment
THEBRUTE-NOURISH.title: Nourish
THEBRUTE-NOURISH.description:
Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your last played Attack or Skill.
THEBRUTE-OVERLOOK.title: Overlook
THEBRUTE-HIGH_ROLLER.title: High Roller
THEBRUTE-HIGH_ROLLER.description: Whenever you gain or lose [gold]Gold[/gold], gain {HighRollerPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CRUEL_STRIKE.title: Cruel Strike
THEBRUTE-REAR_HOOK.title: Rear Hook
THEBRUTE-REAR_HOOK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] {Cards:cond:>1?{Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}|a card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
THEBRUTE-VICTIMIZE.title: Victimize
THEBRUTE-BLOOD_COAGULANT.title: Blood Coagulant
THEBRUTE-BLOOD_COAGULANT.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Gain {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
Gain {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] this turn.
THEBRUTE-POISON_MIND.title: Poison Mind
THEBRUTE-FIRST_CLASS.title: First Class
THEBRUTE-FIRST_CLASS.description:
Deal damage equal to{ExtraAsPercent:cond:!=100? {ExtraAsPercent:diff()}% of|} ALL [gold]Gold[/gold] gained and lost this combat.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
THEBRUTE-DESPERATION.title: Desperation
THEBRUTE-DESPERATION.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Put ALL 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].

THEBRUTE-ACCUMULATE.title: Accumulate

THEBRUTE-ACCIDENT.description: Whenever you gain or lose [gold]Gold[/gold], a random enemy takes {AccidentPower:diff()} damage.
THEBRUTE-RECKLESS_STRIKE.title: Reckless Strike
THEBRUTE-RECKLESS_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold] cost to {Cards:cond:>1?{Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}|a card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:cond:>1?{Cards:plural:them|them}|it}.
THEBRUTE-RUSH.title: Rush
THEBRUTE-RUSH.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
THEBRUTE-MASSACRE.title: Massacre
THEBRUTE-MASSACRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If you gained or lost [gold]Gold[/gold] this turn, hits {Repeat:diff()} times.
THEBRUTE-TOTALITY.title: Totality

THEBRUTE-EXPLOSION.title: Explosion
THEBRUTE-EXPLOSION.description:

(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
THEBRUTE-DIVERGE.title: Diverge
THEBRUTE-IMMUNIZE.title: Immunize
THEBRUTE-IMMUNIZE.description: Whenever you lose Max HP, other players gain {ImmunizePower:diff()} Max HP.
THEBRUTE-INFUSE.title: Infuse
THEBRUTE-INFUSE.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:diff()} random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-DEGRADE.title: Degrade
THEBRUTE-DEGRADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you gained [gold]Thorns[/gold] this turn, hits {Repeat:diff()} {Repeat:plural:time|times}.
THEBRUTE-AMEND.title: Amend
THEBRUTE-AMEND.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Transform {Cards:cond:>1?{Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}|a card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]Ridicule[/gold].
THEBRUTE-REVEAL_WEAKNESS.title: Reveal Weakness
THEBRUTE-LASH_OUT.title: Lash Out
THEBRUTE-LASH_OUT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CHARGE_AHEAD.title: Charge Ahead
THEBRUTE-HOLD_OUT.title: Hold Out
THEBRUTE-ENVELOP.title: Envelop
THEBRUTE-ENVELOP.description:
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
Put {Cards:cond:>1?{Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}|a card} from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-ENVELOP.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Amount:plural:a card|[blue]{}[/blue] cards} to put on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-ATTUNE.title: Attune
THEBRUTE-ATTUNE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Next turn, put up to {AttunePower} {AttunePower:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].

THEBRUTE-GUARD.title: Guard
THEBRUTE-EMBARRASS.title: Embarrass

THEBRUTE-IMPULSE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Play ALL Attacks from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-COMBO.title: Combo
THEBRUTE-COMBO.description: This turn, your next Attack is played {ComboPower:diff()} extra {ComboPower:plural:time|times}.

(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}

Every {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:Attack|Attacks} you play in a turn, put this into your [gold]Hand[/gold].

THEBRUTE-HEAVE.title: Heave
THEBRUTE-HEAVE.description:
Lose {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold] X times.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-HUNKER_DOWN.title: Hunker Down
THEBRUTE-SAFEGUARD.title: Safeguard
THEBRUTE-SAFEGUARD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
When [gold]Retained[/gold], increase its [gold]Block[/gold] by {RetainBlock:diff()} this combat.
THEBRUTE-RIPOSTE.title: Riposte
THEBRUTE-RIPOSTE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Attacks cost {RipostePower:diff()} less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} this turn.
You cannot gain [gold]Block[/gold] from cards for {NoBlockPower:diff()} {NoBlockPower:plural:turn|turns}.
THEBRUTE-SALVAGE.title: Salvage
THEBRUTE-STEAL.title: Steal
THEBRUTE-STEAL.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
THEBRUTE-USURP.title: Usurp
THEBRUTE-USURP.description:
Lose {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
THEBRUTE-EXTEND.title: Extend
THEBRUTE-EXTEND.description:
Gain {ThornsPower2:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
At the start of the next {ExtendPower:diff()} {ExtendPower:plural:turn|turns}, gain {TemporaryThornsUpPower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold] for that turn.
THEBRUTE-GLUTTONY.title: Gluttony
THEBRUTE-GASH.title: Gash
THEBRUTE-GASH.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
If you gained or lost Max HP this turn, deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
THEBRUTE-DISINTER.title: Disinter
THEBRUTE-DISINTER.description:
Lose {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
Permanently increase this card's [gold]Gold[/gold] cost by {GoldCostIncrease} and Max HP gain by {MaxHpGainIncrease}.

THEBRUTE-DECEIVE.description: The third Skill you play each turn is played an extra {DeceivePower:cond:>1?{DeceivePower} times|time}.
THEBRUTE-GOUGE.title: Gouge
THEBRUTE-GOUGE.description:
Remove all [gold]Block[/gold] from ALL enemies.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
THEBRUTE-QUELL.title: Quell
THEBRUTE-QUELL.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.

THEBRUTE-RIDICULE.title: Ridicule
THEBRUTE-GNAW.title: Gnaw
THEBRUTE-GNAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.

THEBRUTE-OVERKILL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
ALL enemies lose {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
THEBRUTE-CRYBLOOD.title: Cryblood
THEBRUTE-CRYBLOOD.description:
At the start of your turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {ExtraAsPercent:diff()}% of your Max HP.{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold])|}
THEBRUTE-RACEMIZATION.title: Racemization
THEBRUTE-RACEMIZATION.description:
Lose {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
THEBRUTE-SURGE.title: Surge
THEBRUTE-SURGE.description:
Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
At the end of your turn, lose {SurgePower:diff()} Max HP.
THEBRUTE-UNRAVEL.title: Unravel
THEBRUTE-UNRAVEL.description:
{MaxHp:cond:>0?Gain {MaxHp:diff()} Max HP.
|}Whenever you lose Max HP, gain {UnravelPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
THEBRUTE-MALICE.title: Malice
THEBRUTE-MALICE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Decrease the damage of this card by {Decrease} this combat.
Put this card on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
THEBRUTE-AUTOTHYSIS.title: Autothysis
THEBRUTE-AUTOTHYSIS.description:
Can only be played if you lost {MaxHpLostRequirement} or more Max HP this combat.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
THEBRUTE-CLAVICULA_NOX.title: Clavicula Nox
THEBRUTE-LOAN.title: Loan
THEBRUTE-LOAN.description:
Lose {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
Prevent the next {BufferPower:cond:>1?{BufferPower:diff()} times|time} you would lose HP.
THEBRUTE-KINTSUGI.title: Kintsugi
THEBRUTE-KINTSUGI.description:
Gain {CalculationExtra:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Gold[/gold] related card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold])|}
THEBRUTE-ZONE.title: Zone
THEBRUTE-ZONE.description:
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you gained [gold]Thorns[/gold] this turn, gain {CalculationExtra:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold].
THEBRUTE-JURY_RIG.title: Jury Rig
THEBRUTE-JURY_RIG.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
When this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], lose {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
THEBRUTE-YOWL.title: Yowl
THEBRUTE-YOWL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
If this kills any enemy, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
THEBRUTE-STRIKE_A_DEAL.title: Strike a Deal
THEBRUTE-STRIKE_A_DEAL.description:
ALL allies gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
[red]Vakuu will play the next{PossessionPower:cond:==1?|>1? {}|} {PossessionPower:plural:turn|turns} for you.[/red]
THEBRUTE-FERVOR.title: Fervor
THEBRUTE-FERVOR.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Upgrade[/gold] {Cards:diff()} random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in each player's [gold]Draw[/gold] and [gold]Discard Piles[/gold].
THEBRUTE-VALORIZE.title: Valorize
THEBRUTE-ADAPT.title: Adapt
THEBRUTE-WEAPONIZE.title: Weaponize
THEBRUTE-WEAPONIZE.description: Whenever you attack an enemy this turn, gain {WeaponizePower:diff()} [gold]Thorns[/gold].
THEBRUTE-UNFLINCHING.title: Unflinching
THEBRUTE-UNFLINCHING.description:
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
Reduce your [gold]Maximum Hand Size[/gold] by {ReducedMaximumHandSizePower:diff()}.
THEBRUTE-ANATHEMA.title: Anathema
THEBRUTE-ANATHEMA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.

THEBRUTE-SNEIKBITE.title: Sneikbite
